title: Quorum quenching of phenolic compounds from Leptolyngbya spp. MACC 32 via downregulation of the periplasmic receptor LuxP in Vibrio harveyi: Hinting a putative mechanism.
authors: Saranya, Madiyan; Ryu, Byeol; Seena, Jose; Silpa, Bhaskaran; Ahna, Ameer; Naman, C Benjamin; Glukhov, Evgenia; Sajeevan, T P; Singh, I S Bright; Gerwick, William H; Valsamma, Joseph
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蓝藻酚类化合物通过下调LuxP等群体感应蛋白抑制哈维弧菌，虽含分子对接但对象为细菌群体感应蛋白-小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Vibrio harveyi causes vibriosis, leading to high mortality and economic loss in global aquaculture. Quorum sensing (QS) driven biofilm formation makes them more resistant to various control measures. This study examined QS inhibition (QSI) of V. harveyi LB3 using marine cyanobacterial natural products. Qualitative and quantitative (88%) assays confirmed the quorum quenching (QQ) efficiency of the intracellular component of Leptolyngbya spp. MACC 32. The active fraction (E3) of the extract showed less than 50% toxicity to PmLyo-Sf9 cells and brine shrimp at 1 mg mL(-1). At MIC (0.06 mg mL(-1)), E3 reduced biofilm biomass by 40-45% and metabolic activity by 10-20% without affecting bacterial growth. V. harveyi LB3 treated with E3 showed less gelatinase (64.75%), hemolytic activity (17.55%), motility (8-16%) and reduced EPS formation (45.5%), indicating its anti-virulence properties. HPLC, (1)H NMR, and GC-MS analyses confirmed that E3 contains 4-hydroxybenzoic acid (4-HBA) and 4-hydroxybenzaldehyde (4-HBAL). Synthetic controls validated the QQ of 4-HBA and 4-HBAL. Molecular docking studies hinted at the putative interaction of 4-HBA and 4-HBAL with QS proteins (LuxR, LuxP, LuxM, LuxN, LuxQ, LuxU, LuxO and LuxS) of V. harveyi. Gene expression studies showed strong LuxR, LuxP, LuxQ, and ToxR downregulation (61-97%), differential upregulation of LuxO, LuxU, aphA, qrr1-qrr5 (9-18%), and LuxS, LuxM, LuxN, Fur (2-4%). Although not confirmed with mutant strains, this study provides strong evidence that phenolic compounds from Leptolyngbya spp. MACC 32 inhibited V. harveyi LB3 QS by blocking AI-2 binding to LuxP, supporting their role in shrimp health management through the control of vibriosis.
abstract_zh: 哈维氏弧菌（Vibrio harveyi）引起弧菌病，导致全球水产养殖业高死亡率和经济损失。群体感应（quorum sensing, QS）驱动的生物膜形成使其对各种控制措施更具抵抗力。本研究探讨了海洋蓝藻天然产物对哈维氏弧菌LB3的群体感应抑制（QSI）作用。定性和定量（88%）分析确认了细鞘蓝藻属（Leptolyngbya spp.）MACC 32胞内组分的群体淬灭（quorum quenching, QQ）效率。提取物的活性组分（E3）在1 mg mL(-1)浓度下对PmLyo-Sf9细胞和卤虫的毒性低于50%。在最低抑菌浓度（MIC，0.06 mg mL(-1)）下，E3使生物膜生物量减少40-45%，代谢活性降低10-20%，且不影响细菌生长。经E3处理的哈维氏弧菌LB3表现出明胶酶活性降低（64.75%）、溶血活性降低（17.55%）、运动性减弱（8-16%）以及胞外多糖（EPS）形成减少（45.5%），表明其具有抗毒力特性。高效液相色谱（HPLC）、核磁共振氢谱（(1)H NMR）和气相色谱-质谱联用（GC-MS）分析确认E3含有4-羟基苯甲酸（4-HBA）和4-羟基苯甲醛（4-HBAL）。合成对照验证了4-HBA和4-HBAL的群体淬灭活性。分子对接研究提示4-HBA和4-HBAL与哈维氏弧菌QS蛋白（LuxR、LuxP、LuxM、LuxN、LuxQ、LuxU、LuxO和LuxS）存在潜在相互作用。基因表达研究显示LuxR、LuxP、LuxQ和ToxR显著下调（61-97%），LuxO、LuxU、aphA、qrr1-qrr5差异上调（9-18%），以及LuxS、LuxM、LuxN、Fur上调（2-4%）。尽管未通过突变株进行确认，本研究提供了强有力的证据表明细鞘蓝藻属MACC 32的酚类化合物通过阻断AI-2与LuxP结合来抑制哈维氏弧菌LB3的QS，支持其在通过控制弧菌病进行虾类健康管理中的作用。
